name: Rolen Splitcuff Convertible Arm Sleeve — Pair
description: Stretchy thermal-mesh arm sleeves that zip on at the shoulder and peel off in seconds, transitioning from morning frost cover to bare-arm afternoon. Charcoal grey with a faint herringbone weave, thumb-loop anchors at the wrist end. Chrome-socket cutouts at the inner elbow accommodate standard aug fittings without bunching.
functionality: Zip-on/zip-off shoulder attachment; thumb loops for wrist anchor; aug-socket cutouts at elbow.
what_it_says: You've learned to dress for M88 weather the hard way and you're not interested in freezing or sweating.
story_hooks: One sleeve has a faded serial number inked near the cuff — someone marked these before losing them.
The zip mechanism on the left sleeve jams at exactly 7°C, which is exactly when you need it most.
related_entities: Novafold Pharmaceuticals GraftSkin TS-7 Bioprinted Dermal Replacement Sheet

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, minimalist arm sleeves that hug the bicep and forearm with a subtle athletic taper. They read as utilitarian and modular—designed to be peeled on and off without ceremony. The thumb-loops create small anchor points at the wrists, giving the sleeves a finished, intentional look even when removed.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fitted through the upper arm, gradually relaxing toward the wrist. Stretchy enough to accommodate augmented limbs without restriction, but snug enough to stay in place during movement or labor.
physical_description.primary_material: Thermal-mesh synth-blend—breathable yet insulating, engineered for rapid temperature regulation.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, faintly raised herringbone weave visible under direct light. Stretchy micro-ribbed interior for grip and moisture-wicking. The chrome socket cutouts have smooth, beveled edges.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey as primary. Chrome socket fittings provide subtle metallic accents at the inner elbow. Faint herringbone pattern breaks up the flatness without drawing attention.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic zip closure at the shoulder seam (quick-release design). Friction-fit thumb loops at wrist anchoring.
distinctive_features: Chrome-socket cutouts at inner elbow—sized for standard augmentation quick-connect fittings
Magnetic shoulder zip rated for one-handed operation
Thumb-loop anchors prevent sleeve drift during repetitive motion
Herringbone weave texture adds visual interest without pattern noise
Seam-sealed edges reduce fraying and extend wear life
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional—affordable working-class gear with practical augmentation compatibility. Not luxury, not salvage.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by dock workers, maintenance techs, warehouse operators, and anyone with cybernetic augmentations working variable-temperature environments. Signals hands-on labor and integration with chrome, but not desperation or wealth.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but maintained. Minor pilling on the interior where it contacts skin. Thermal-mesh fibers may show faint discoloration from sweat or industrial dust. Magnetic zips remain responsive.
